info.title: Jaw bone lesion detection app
info.summary: A jaw bone lesion detection program.
info.description: This is an app that classifies jaw bone lesions.

servers.description: Alternative API root endpoint on Render cloud

post.summary: Find jaw bone lesions based on patient symptoms
post.description: This endpoint receives symptoms from the patient and returns the list of most relevant jaw bone lesion by percentage

requestBody.description: Request body contains the value for each symptom given by the user

pain_0.title: Pain
pain_0.description: pain (facial or tooth or general pain)

trismus.title: Trismus
trismus.description: muscle trismus or limitation of mouth opening

impact.title: Impacted, unerupted or supernumerary tooth
impact.description: impacted or unerupted tooth at lesion site

history_of_surgery.title: History of surgery, trauma or tooth extraction
history_of_surgery.description: history of surgery, trauma or tooth extraction

slow_0.title: Slow (Months to years)
slow_0.description: slow growth of lesion (lesion has appeared or existed for months or even years)

moderate_0.title: Moderate (weeks to about 2months)
moderate_0.description: moderate growth of lesion (lesion has appeared or existed less than two months but more than a week)

rapid_0.title: Rapid (Hours to days)
rapid_0.description: rapid growth of lesion (lesion has appeared or existed within afew hours or days )

hemorrhage.title: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.description: hemorrheage or bleeding from lesion site or soft tissue lesion

nonvital.title: Nonvital tooth
nonvital.description: nonvital tooth or negative tooth vitality test

pain_1.title: Pain
pain_1.description: tooth is sensetive to percussion or tooth has pain on percussion

pump.title: Pumping tooth
pump.description: pumping tooth or tooth pumps-up on percussion or pressure

auscultation.title: Auscultation
auscultation.description: posetive ausculation test or lesion has throbbing sound

soft.title: Soft
soft.description: lesion has soft consistancy on palpation

rubbery.title: Rubbery
rubbery.description: lesion has rubbery consistancy on palpation

firm.title: Firm
firm.description: lesion has firm consistancy on palpation

bony_hard.title: Bony-hard
bony_hard.description: lesion has bony-hard consistancy on palpation

scalloped.title: Scalloped
scalloped.description: lesion has scalloped shape or border

non_corticated.title: Non corticated
non_corticated.description: lesion has well-defined and non-corticated border

corticated.title: Corticated
corticated.description: lesion has well-defined and corticated border

sclerotic.title: Sclerotic
sclerotic.description: lesion has well-defined and sclerotic border

soft_capsule.title: Radiolucent rim (Soft capsule)
soft_capsule.description: lesion has well-defined border with radiolucent rim (soft capsule)

blending.title: Blending border
blending.description: lesion has ill-defined and blending border

invasive.title: Invasive and Destructive border
invasive.description: lesion has ill-defined and invasive border

unilateral_right.title: Right
unilateral_right.description: Unilateral lesion at right side of mandible or maxilla

unilateral_left.title: Left
unilateral_left.description: Unilateral lesion at left side of mandible or maxilla

bilateral.title: Bilateral
bilateral.description: Bilateral lesion at both sides of mandible or maxilla

pericoronal.title: Pericoronal (Coronal to CEJ)
pericoronal.description: Epicenter of lesion is in pericoronal position to tooth (lesion is coronal to CEJ)

interradicular.title: Root (Interradicular, Midroot or whole root)
interradicular.description: Epicenter of lesion is around whole root or mid root or between roots

periapical.title: Periapical (Only apex area)
periapical.description: Epicenter of lesion is around the apex of tooth (periapical)

solitary.title: Solitary
solitary.description: There is only one lesion or lesion type is solitary

multiple_separate.title: Multiple seprate
multiple_separate.description: There are multiple seperate lesion or lesion type is multipe seprate

radiopaue_zone.title: With radiolucent zone
radiopaue_zone.description: radiopaque internal strcuture with radioclucent zone within it (radiolucent rim)

radiopaque_nozone.title: No specific zone
radiopaque_nozone.description: radiopaque or completely radiopaque internal structure

uni2.title: Radiolucent with flecks
uni2.description: radiolucent internal structure with flecks (radiopaque zone) within it

wispy1.title: Wispy or Thin
wispy1.description: multilocular internal structure with linear wispy septa

coarse1.title: Coarse or Thick
coarse1.description: multilocular internal structure with linear coarse septa

wispy2.title: Wispy or Thin
wispy2.description: multilocular internal structure with curved wispy septa

coarse2.title: Coarse or Thick
coarse2.description: multilocular internal structure with curved coarse septa

dura.title: Loss of lamina dura (without root resorption)
dura.description: lamina dura is lost or destructed

sinus.title: Invagination to sinus space
sinus.description: invagination of lesion to sinus space

expand.title: Expansion or displacement without destruction or perforation
expand.description: Only Expansion or displacement of cortical bone without destruction or perforation

destruct_3.title: Expansion or displacement with destruction or perforation
destruct_3.description: Expansion and Destruction or perforation of cortical bone

extend.title: Extension within bone without expansion or destruction
extend.description: Extension within bone without expansion or destruction of cortical bone

Alexis.description: A 32-year old female, with no systematic disease or pain, was incidentally diagnosed with a lesion in the left mandible about two month ago after taking a radiograph. On the panoramic image, A well-defined corticated radiolucent lesion is observed on the left side of the mandible, associated with the peri coronal region of third molar. The lesion shows bone extension but has not caused any bony expansion.

Barbara.description: 24 old female with report of swelling or pain which she reported gradually increased in 2years. The lesion was hard on palpation.Panoramic findings illustrates unilateral, solitary, mixed radiolucent and radiopaque non-odontogenic lesion with irregular, ill-defined , and blending border in Rt side of mandible at ramus to incisors region with expansion of cortical bone and loss of lamina dura.
